create_VirtualFileSystem: create a VirtualFileSystem instance to manage sandbox file operations with backward compatibility
cat_VirtualFileSystem: read the contents of a file in the sandbox file system as bytes
mkdir_VirtualFileSystem: create a directory in the sandbox file system with optional recursive parent creation
ls_VirtualFileSystem: list the contents of a directory in the sandbox file system with optional detail
tree_VirtualFileSystem: generate a tree view string of the directory structure in the sandbox file system
